text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing, Mejiro 
McQueen and I dropped by the shopping 
district. Just then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh my? There seems to be a crowd gathering 
over there.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A lottery... that sounds rather fun. I 
wonder if there is a surefire winning 
strategy?
choice_data_list: Luck is the only thing you can count on

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Just luck...! Well, at least there is no 
hesitation in that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Status and past efforts mean nothing. All 
that matters is whether you have it or you 
don't.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I would love to shine in a place with no 
such favoritism!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Let's go get some lottery tickets right 
away. We can buy a few ribbons and...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And so, I got one lottery ticket.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now then, we only have one chance. Let us 
maintain our focus, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying our prayers together, we gripped 
the lever side by side and spun the raffle 
wheel.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result is—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh, is that true!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we did it! It's the grand prize! 
The grand prize!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A hot spring trip for the two of us... How 
utterly wonderful that would be!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the autumn leaves, eating 
delicious food, soaking in a wonderful hot 
spring, and then...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh... W-Wait a second!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(Could it be that I've pulled something 
unbelievable...? A hot springs trip!?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(Rushing ahead alone lacks grace. Yes, 
here I should leave it to my partner...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...*ahem* Now that I think about it, the 
use of this ticket is not strictly limited 
to a single purpose.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, here you go. You may use it as 
you see fit."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(This is the best way...! If I do it like 
this, it'll be good for Trainer...)
choice_data_list:
No, it's a gift, so choose whatever you 
like.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? H-Hold on, this is troubled! After 
all my effort to esc... Wait, what...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(You dummy, dummy! Why are you hitting it 
back?! Now it looks like I'm the only one 
who wanted this...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (Now that it's come to this――!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —I shall place that on hold.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. To ensure fairness, I would prefer 
that you hold onto it, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I shall deliberate with utmost care 
before deciding how to use it. After all, 
it is an immense privilege."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Things got blown way out of proportion, 
but I ended up holding onto the grand 
prize ticket after all.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, carrot hamburg steak! My, you've 
treated me to something truly delectable.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: B-But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You can have this. If I were to eat it, 
I'd get fa—er, it wouldn't be right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you the one who wants to eat it, 
Trainer? You don't have to force yourself 
on my account.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Please tell me you want to eat it! 
Otherwise, I shall take it for myself, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Don't you "here you go" me! Ugh, you are 
unbelievable~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case, let us eat together. 
If we split it in half, the deliciousness 
remains the same, while the calories are 
halved.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, it might taste twice as good 
together... Or maybe instead of 
delicious... I mean happy?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-It's nothing... I simply drew a good 
card and got a little excited, is all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, the two of them happily shared 
the hamburger steak together.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Second prize... It's a decent result, but 
surprisingly, I feel quite a sense of 
accomplishment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To turn a single sheet of paper into a 
whole mountain of them. Wouldn't you 
consider that an accomplishment in its own 
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That is perfectly acceptable to me. Well 
then, let us be on our way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, that is true. I am allowed to 
have it, correct?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it's not like I drew it for the 
prize, after all."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to shine, given that one 
chance. That's all it was...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And so, it's troubling to receive all 
this. There's just so much...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, the massive pile of carrots 
was sent to the Mejiro estate... and 
later, an invitation to a "Carrot Banquet" 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize... Just a single carrot... 
Somehow, this leaves me feeling terribly 
unsatisfied.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Is this the limit of my stature...? To 
think it's only one...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—By the way, Trainer, do you know what 
season comes after winter?
choice_data_list: It's spring, isn't it? But why?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My, there's a boutique right there. If I 
buy clothes over there, I'll end up with 
lottery tickets even without asking for 
them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, as reluctant as I am, I'll 
just have to draw another one... Excuse me 
for a moment."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I stopped her from wasting money on 
something obvious. She seemed pretty 
frustrated about it.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Tissues... Hehehe, this is just perfect. I 
actually wanted some.
choice_data_list: What are you going to use it for?
What are you going to use it for?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To wipe away my tears of frustration, of 
course. Uuu, and I pulled with such high 
hopes, too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "I do not need it! I... I love tissues!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Would a single pack of pocket tissues 
really be enough? That's how utterly 
devastated Mejiro McQueen was...
